description: FDA recalls and adverse event reports (CAERS) for one supplement, from openFDA. Give a product name, barcode, DSLD ID, or brand and name. Recalls are listed only when they carry the barcode or the brand and every product-name word; adverse event reports are counted with their most common reactions. Reports do not show that a product caused an event.

name.description: Product name as printed, used with "brand" when the product is not in DSLD

query.description: Product as the user named it; resolved to a DSLD label

upc.description: UPC-A or EAN barcode digits as printed on the bottle, e.g. "031604026974" (spaces and dashes are ignored)

name: products_fda_reports
